data.title: Export your data
data.lead: Download a .zip with your account's data. It is prepared in the background; you can leave the page while it runs.

password.title: Change password
password.lead: Every other device is signed out after the change; this session stays. The API token does not change.
password.changed: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.

token.title: API token
token.lead: For command-line tools and submit scripts. A token is shown exactly once after it is created; an old one cannot be shown again.
token.copyNow: Copy it now. Once you leave this page the token cannot be shown again. The old token no longer works.
token.risk: Anyone holding the token can submit as you. Changing the password does not revoke it; create a new token if it may have leaked.
token.confirmBody: The current token stops working at once. Scripts using it fail until you give them the new one. The new token is shown once.

logoutAll.title: Sign out everywhere
logoutAll.lead: Ends every session, this device included. You will need to sign in again.
logoutAll.confirmBody: Every session, this device included, ends now. You will be taken to the sign-in page.
